environment.description: Ruby on Rails 7.0 application deployed on a single EC2 instance running Puma behind an nginx reverse proxy. The application serves documents from local filesystem storage. nginx is configured with default settings and passes all request parameters through to the Rails application. No path normalization or request filtering is applied at the proxy layer. The storage directory contains documents organized by organization_id with sensitive configuration files in parent directories.

config.nginx_config: proxy_pass http://puma_upstream with no path filtering
config.filesystem: ext4, no chroot, app runs as www-data with read access to /app/storage/
